name: English
guidance: Keep the existing US/UK spelling and the document’s chosen voice; do not switch dialects.
Use a concrete subject and verb when the actor is known. Keep passive voice when the actor is unknown or irrelevant.
Remove empty lead-ins and unsupported superlatives; retain technical terms with precise meanings.
Keep may, can, must, should and negation distinct. A possibility is not a guarantee or requirement.
Keep articles, countability, singular/plural agreement and parallel imperative steps natural.
Preserve API names, units, decimal points and citations; use sentence case only when it fits the existing heading convention.

rules.pattern: \b(?:it is important to note that|it is worth noting that|it should be noted that)\b
rules.message: Remove the lead-in if it adds no qualification.
rules.example: It should be noted that the solver records samples.

rules.message: Consider “to” when the purpose remains clear.
rules.example: Run this command in order to inspect the log.

rules.pattern: \b(?:perform an analysis of|conduct an evaluation of)\b
rules.message: Consider a direct verb; keep established technical procedure names.
rules.example: Perform an analysis of the output.

rules.message: Check the evidence and replace unsupported promotion with a specific capability.

examples.review: It should be noted that the solver records 20 samples.
